Configure current feature

  1. Create the small GameService development deployment and base accounts/characters/appearance/command_receipts models. No client SQL connection is permitted.
  2. Implement API_Identity/API_Characters and a provider adapter with isolated development credentials. Configure DA_Environment_Development; secrets live outside Content and docs.
  3. Open L_FrontEnd with BP_MenuGameMode and no gameplay pawn. Bind WBP_Login, roster, WBP_CharacterCreate and BP_PreviewAvatar to the local screen router. Author four class IDs but expose only ready appearance options.

Only place actors whose systems are active in this phase; later rows are staged expansion instructions, not a requirement to build all map content now. Keep placeholders labeled and preserve earlier test sections.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Log in DevAccountA, request character slots and create Character_A as Vanguard using a selected common-body appearance and unique creation CommandId.
  2. Send the same create request twice, then disconnect immediately after the response could have committed.
  3. Log in again, fetch roster and preview the saved class/hair/palette/outfit. Create Character_B for a second account as Ranger.
  4. Request deletion using typed confirmation, then exercise the documented retention-window recovery flow in a disposable fixture.
Expected success
The same creation command resolves to one CharacterId and one starter grant policy, never an extra slot/body.
Appearance comes from persisted validated option IDs, not a local screenshot; invalid names have structured rejection text and focus returns correctly.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Full inventory/XP hydration and durable single-character session fencing are phase05. Online appearance observation is verified again once admitted. No invented race silhouettes.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureDuplicate/forbidden/confusable name and invalid class/appearance combination reject without consuming a slot.
current-phase fixtureDelete another account’s CharacterId -> Forbidden. Reusing a CommandId with a changed name -> IdempotencyConflict.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Creation is server/backend validated; previews never become persistent authority.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
